a.lede: An internal post urging the board to consider employee sentiment about Nvidia’s former CEO has drawn more than 1,600 comments, the majority in full support of reinstalling him.
a.title: ‘Bring Back THE Boss’: Nvidia Employees Petition for Jensen Huang’s Return

b.lede: Nvidia’s longtime chief financial officer helped transform the company into an AI powerhouse. Now she’s taking the reins following Jensen Huang’s resignation on Thursday.
b.title: Meet Colette Kress, Nvidia’s New Interim CEO
